_comment: Reference copy of the EC2 instance role's permissions, for review.
The authoritative definition is inline in cloudformation/cryptiq-demo.yaml
(resources are resolved there with account/region/log-group ARNs).
The role also attaches the AWS managed policy
baseline for SSM Session Manager. It is NOT an administrator policy: it
permits the SSM agent's own API calls, ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation, and a
scoped ssmmessages / ec2messages / s3 (SSM binaries) / kms set. No EC2, IAM,
or account-wide permissions are granted anywhere on this role.
